import { GachaDs3LegendaryChild } from './GachaDs3LegendaryChild';

// Phase 2: tab → ChildPanel resolver (inside CompositePanel class)
private _resolveChildPanelForTab(tabId: string): typeof ChildPanelBase | null {
    switch (tabId) {
      case 'general': return GachaDs3GeneralChild;
      case 'legendary': return GachaDs3LegendaryChild;
      case 'support': return GachaDs3SupportChild;
      default: return null;
    }
}

private _resolveMountForTab(tabId: string): string | null {
    switch (tabId) {
      case 'general': return 'TabGeneralContent';
      case 'legendary': return 'TabLegendaryContent';
      case 'support': return 'TabSupportContent';
      default: return null;
    }
}
